Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire/aim that direction and set facing; movement and firing combine in one action; Space = use active item; Q = use held card/consumable (effect unconfirmed); wait delays. Movement ~400px/s; full step ~110px, diagonal ~55px; short 0.1–0.15s presses give fine alignment. Doors/hatches need near-exact centering and repeated presses while centered.

MECHANICS (observed): HUD shows hearts (hollow when lost; after red pills an extra blue-outlined heart appeared, so up to 3 red + 1 blue), coins, keys, bombs. Pickups collected on touch: floor coin disks/specks, key pickups, hovering fuse-lit bomb (+1 bomb observed earlier), red pill = health restore (+blue heart), blue pill = +1 key (01→02). Locked gray chests open after pressing into them several times with a key held; key counter did not visibly decrease; contents pop out (Match Stick 'Tastes like burning' collected, became a held flame). Plain poop is destroyable but dropped nothing; gilded mound shatters into coins. Card pickup 'II – The High Priestess — Mother is watching you'. Green clouds from dying shelled enemies damage on touch. TNT barrels are immune to plain tears AND Tech X rings; they chain-detonate from a bomb blast (observed a red bomb entity exploding and chaining the whole barrel column, dropping coins/flames).

TECH X (observed): radial ring tear travels ~120px ahead then bursts with ~1.5-tile radius wide arc; red crack/X overlay marks damage location; short range so must close in but not point-blank. It damages gilded mounds, fat enemies and the wall statue (cracks), but not TNT barrels. Match Stick showed no visible effect on Space (likely passive).

PLAYER SPRITE: appearance alternates wildly (white round face, TV/monitor face, striped egg, helmet, basket, bald figure, flame-holding, golden/red damage flash) and is sometimes invisible for frames; confirm identity by moving and seeing which sprite responds. Enemies never show the screen face. Red crack on player = taking damage.

ENEMIES (observed): winged flies; fat pink/white-faced (tanky, enrage with dark mouth, chase, black teardrops fall, point-blank contact drains hearts fast; die to sustained rings from range); knife-topped; shelled white-faced emerging from rock piles (exposed first, re-shield after knockback, die leaving damaging green cloud); blue orbs (drift, poppable by tears, contact seemed harmless for many frames); blue-white creature; fire-skull; horned fat variants; disguised enemies that look like static black teardrop pegs (damage reveals them—one was a spiky-haired white-faced enemy). Pink stationary object survived direct hits and kept emitting orbs (suspect invulnerable spawner, unconfirmed). Blue spiral spinner wedged in right rocks resisted many ring hits (decor suspected).

BOSS/WALL STATUE (uncertain): left-wall gray stone face/altar holding gold item, cycling glowing red eyes, sprays blood-mist; shows ring damage cracks but has not died—may be invincible decor or a boss gating the hatch (unconfirmed). A giant bare leg in a red high-heel shoe appeared as a boss in the top room (stomps/retracts); a gray face peeking from the top wall was suspected to be another enemy. Room exits stayed locked throughout these fights.

DOORS/ROOMS: doors and hatches remain locked until the room is cleared (repeatedly observed); top-wall brown marks in the boss room were NOT doors (no transition). Rock room's left gold keyhole door opens with a key into a SHOP (pedestal items e.g. 15¢ card, 5¢ bomb; coins presumably auto-charged on touch); shop's right gold door exits back to the rock room.

NAVIGATION (observed chain): Tutorial (top door, bottom door, inert wall diagrams) ↔ bottom door → brazier room (four lit corner braziers, locked chest sealed inside rock ring, shootable poop left of ring, golden gate bottom-center, top alcove back to tutorial) ↔ golden gate → item room (pedestal TECH X; floor pickups; top gold door back to brazier room). Tutorial top door → rock room (scattered rocks, left keyhole door→shop, top and bottom doors; enemy waves incl. shelled, flies, knife, orbs, spinner) → top → TNT room (left barrel column guarding two locked chests, center barrels, top hatch, bottom door back to rock room) → top hatch → boss room (rocky right side with green sprouts, gilded mound among rocks, left-wall statue with red eyes/gold item, decorative top-wall marks, floor card, blue spiral + sack in right rocks; fat/knife enemies, later the high-heel leg boss; bottom hatch back toward TNT room).

FAILED STRATEGIES: walking into the brazier-room rock ring (chest sealed from all sides); plain poop gave nothing; left-wall blue wall-crack mark inert to tears; pink spawner took no damage; attacking TNT barrels with tears/Tech X (immune); Space with Match Stick; pressing decorative top-wall marks; point-blank fighting fat enemies; lingering in green clouds/teardrop lanes; ignoring static 'props' that may be disguised enemies; firing rings from <60px often bursts past the target (aim from ~120–150px).

UNRESOLVED HYPOTHESES: whether doors unlock only on full clear; whether the wall statue is invincible decor or a boss; whether the boss-room hatch requires the boss kill; whether blue spiral/sack in rocks are enemies or decor; whether the pink object is an invulnerable spawner; where the golden key is (keys seen only from pills/floor pickups this run); what the card (Q) does; whether all-hollow hearts indicate a revive/extra-life state; whether green orbs deal damage.
